dense_grid_persistence.input_assumption: last full ERA5 target grid; strong reference with more information than V6

sparse_idw_persistence.input_assumption: same last-hour sparse point values available to V6
sparse_idw_persistence.precipitation_strategy: zero hourly precipitation because tp is absent from V6 input

dense_grid_persistence.definition: 1 - v6_rmse / baseline_rmse; positive means V6 is better

sparse_idw_persistence.definition: 1 - v6_rmse / baseline_rmse; positive means V6 is better
